edits.text: 1. Purchase Price. The Buyer shall pay the Seller USD 40,000,000 for the Shares, subject to the adjustments set forth in this Agreement.
2. Closing. Closing shall occur within 45 days after signing, subject to satisfaction or waiver of the conditions precedent set forth herein.

3. Representations. The Seller represents, subject to the disclosures in the Disclosure Schedule, that: (a) the financial statements have been prepared in accordance with the books and records of the Company and fairly present, in all material respects, the financial condition of the Company; (b) the Seller has full power and authority to enter into and perform this Agreement and consummate the transactions contemplated hereby; (c) the Seller has good and valid title to the Shares, free and clear of all liens, claims, and encumbrances; (d) the Company has no liabilities or obligations required to be disclosed under applicable law except as disclosed or incurred in the ordinary course of business; (e) the Company is, in all material respects, in compliance with applicable laws; and (f) there is no pending or, to the Seller’s knowledge, threatened litigation that would reasonably be expected to have a material adverse effect on the Company.

4. Confidentiality. The terms of this Agreement are confidential, subject to disclosures required by applicable law or regulatory authority and to disclosures to a party’s affiliates, financing sources and potential financing sources, and its and their respective professional advisers (including legal, tax, accounting, and other advisors), in each case on a need-to-know basis and subject to customary confidentiality obligations where reasonably practicable, and as otherwise necessary or advisable in connection with financing, tax, accounting, regulatory, or legal purposes.

receiver.requested_changes:
1) Reduce the purchase price further to USD 35,000,000, or at minimum agree a meaningful escrow/holdback and additional price adjustment mechanism to protect against downside risk.
2) Extend closing to at least 60 days after signing, with Buyer’s right to extend if diligence, regulatory, or financing items remain outstanding.
3) Expand the seller representations to include customary authority, capitalization, title, no undisclosed liabilities, compliance with law, absence of material contracts issues, taxes, employee matters, IP, data/privacy, sanctions/anti-corruption, and no material adverse effect qualification only where market-standard.
4) Make the disclosure schedule specific and complete, with Seller’s knowledge qualifiers limited and defined.
5) Tighten confidentiality so disclosures to financing sources and potential financing sources require prior written consent unless legally required, and remove overly broad “as otherwise necessary or advisable” language.
6) Add a clear bring-down of reps at closing and a robust indemnity regime for breaches.
receiver.message_back:
Dear Counsel,

Thank you for the revised draft. We appreciate the movement on price and the fuller representation package.

That said, the Buyer cannot accept the agreement on the current terms. In particular, the revised price of USD 40 million remains too high given the remaining diligence and allocation of risk, and the closing timetable is still compressed.

Please circulate a further draft that reflects:
- a purchase price of USD 35 million, or, alternatively, a meaningful escrow/holdback and price-adjustment mechanism;
- a closing period of no less than 60 days, with Buyer extension rights for outstanding diligence, regulatory or financing matters;
- a customary, fully rounded seller rep package as set out in our prior comments; and
- tighter confidentiality language, including consent-based disclosure to financing sources.

We would be happy to review a mark-up on that basis.

Best regards,
Bellweather Croft LLP
